verses.original: Εἰ οὖν συνηγέρθητε τῷ Χριστῷ τὰ ἄνω ζητεῖτε οὗ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ καθήμενος
verses.transliteration: Ei oun synēgerthēte tō Christō ta anō zēteite hou ho Christos estin en dexia tou Theou kathēmenos
verses.literal: Therefore since you have been raised with Christ strive for the things above where Christ is seated at the right hand of God
verses.literalPt: PORTANTO, se já ressuscitastes com Cristo, buscai as coisas que são de cima, onde Cristo está assentado à destra de Deus.

verses.original: τὰ ἄνω φρονεῖτε μὴ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: ta anō phroneite mē ta epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: Set your minds on things above not on earthly things
verses.literalPt: Pensai nas coisas que são de cima, e não nas que são da terra;

verses.original: ἀπεθάνετε γάρ καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν κέκρυπται σὺν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: apethanete gar kai hē zōē hymōn kekryptai syn tō Christō en tō Theō
verses.literal: For you died and your life is now hidden with Christ in God
verses.literalPt: Porque já estais mortos, e a vossa vida está escondida com Cristo em Deus.

verses.original: ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς φανερωθῇ ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν τότε καὶ ὑμεῖς σὺν αὐτῷ φανερωθήσεσθε ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: hotan ho Christos phanerōthē hē zōē hymōn tote kai hymeis syn autō phanerōthēsesthe en doxē
verses.literal: When Christ who is your life appears then you also will appear with Him in glory
verses.literalPt: Quando Cristo, que é a nossa vida, se manifestar, então também vós vos manifestareis com ele em glória.

verses.original: Νεκρώσατε οὖν τὰ μέλη τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πορνείαν ἀκαθαρσίαν πάθος ἐπιθυμίαν κακήν καὶ τὴν πλεονεξίαν ἥτις ἐστὶν εἰδωλολατρία
verses.transliteration: Nekrōsate oun ta melē ta epi tēs gēs porneian akatharsian pathos epithymian kakēn kai tēn pleonexian hētis estin eidōlolatria
verses.literal: Put to death therefore the components of your earthly nature sexual immorality impurity lust evil desires and greed which is idolatry
verses.literalPt: Mortificai, pois, os vossos membros, que estão sobre a terra: a prostituição, a impureza, a afeição desordenada, a vil concupiscência, e a avareza, que é idolatria;

verses.original: δι’ ἃ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας
verses.transliteration: di’ ha erchetai hē orgē tou Theou epi tous huious tēs apeitheias
verses.literal: Because of these the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience
verses.literalPt: Pelas quais coisas vem a ira de Deus sobre os filhos da desobediência;

verses.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ὑμεῖς περιεπατήσατέ ποτε ὅτε ἐζῆτε ἐν τούτοις
verses.transliteration: en hois kai hymeis periepatēsate pote hote ezēte en toutois
verses.literal: When you lived among them you also used to walk in these ways
verses.literalPt: Nas quais, também, em outro tempo andastes, quando vivíeis nelas.

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἀπόθεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ πάντα ὀργήν θυμόν κακίαν βλασφημίαν αἰσχρολογίαν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: nyni de apothesthe kai hymeis ta panta orgēn thymon kakian blasphēmian aischrologian ek tou stomatos hymōn
verses.literal: But now you must put aside all such things as these anger rage malice slander and filthy language from your lips
verses.literalPt: Mas agora, despojai-vos também de tudo: da ira, da cólera, da malícia, da maledicência, das palavras torpes da vossa boca.

verses.original: Μὴ ψεύδεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους ἀπεκδυσάμενοι τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον σὺν ταῖς πράξεσιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mē pseudesthe eis allēlous apekdysamenoi ton palaion anthrōpon syn tais praxesin autou
verses.literal: Do not lie to one another since you have taken off the old self with its practices
verses.literalPt: Não mintais uns aos outros, pois que já vos despistes do velho homem com os seus feitos,

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν νέον τὸν ἀνακαινούμενον εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν κατ’ εἰκόνα τοῦ κτίσαντος αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai endysamenoi ton neon ton anakainoumenon eis epignōsin kat’ eikona tou ktisantos auton
verses.literal: and have put on the new self which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator
verses.literalPt: E vos vestistes do novo, que se renova para o conhecimento, segundo a imagem daquele que o criou;

verses.original: ὅπου οὐκ ἔνι Ἕλλην καὶ Ἰουδαῖος περιτομὴ καὶ ἀκροβυστία βάρβαρος Σκύθης δοῦλος ἐλεύθερος ἀλλὰ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν Χριστός
verses.transliteration: hopou ouk eni Hellēn kai Ioudaios peritomē kai akrobystia barbaros Skythēs doulos eleutheros alla ta panta kai en pasin Christos
verses.literal: Here there is no Greek or Jew circumcised or uncircumcised barbarian Scythian slave or free but Christ is all and is in all
verses.literalPt: Onde não há grego, nem judeu, circuncisão, nem incircuncisão, bárbaro, cita, servo ou livre; mas Cristo é tudo em todos.

verses.original: Ἐνδύσασθε οὖν ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ χρηστότητα ταπεινοφροσύνην πραΰτητα μακροθυμίαν
verses.transliteration: Endysasthe oun hōs eklektoi tou Theou hagioi kai ēgapēmenoi splanchna oiktirmou chrēstotēta tapeinophrosynēn prautēta makrothymian
verses.literal: Therefore as the elect of God holy and beloved clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion kindness humility gentleness and patience
verses.literalPt: Revesti-vos, pois, como eleitos de Deus, santos e amados, de entranhas de misericórdia, de benignidade, humildade, mansidão, longanimidade;

verses.original: ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων καὶ χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς ἐάν τις πρός τινα ἔχῃ μομφήν καθὼς καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς
verses.transliteration: anechomenoi allēlōn kai charizomenoi heautois ean tis pros tina echē momphēn kathōs kai ho Kyrios echarisato hymin houtōs kai hymeis
verses.literal: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else Forgive as . . . the Lord forgave you
verses.literalPt: Suportando-vos uns aos outros, e perdoando-vos uns aos outros, se alguém tiver queixa contra outro; assim como Cristo vos perdoou, assim fazei vós também.

verses.original: ἐπὶ πᾶσιν δὲ τούτοις τὴν ἀγάπην ὅ ἐστιν σύνδεσμος τῆς τελειότητος
verses.transliteration: epi pasin de toutois tēn agapēn ho estin syndesmos tēs teleiotētos
verses.literal: And over all these virtues put on love which is the bond of perfect unity
verses.literalPt: E, sobre tudo isto, revesti-vos de amor, que é o vínculo da perfeição.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Χριστοῦ βραβευέτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν εἰς ἣν καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι καὶ εὐχάριστοι γίνεσθε
verses.transliteration: kai hē eirēnē tou Christou brabeuetō en tais kardiais hymōn eis hēn kai eklēthēte en heni sōmati kai eucharistoi ginesthe
verses.literal: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts for to this you were called as members of one body And be thankful
verses.literalPt: E a paz de Deus, para a qual também fostes chamados em um corpo, domine em vossos corações; e sede agradecidos.

verses.original: Ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ψαλμοῖς ὕμνοις ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ἐν τῇ χάριτι ᾄδοντες ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho logos tou Christou enoikeitō en hymin plousiōs en pasē sophia didaskontes kai nouthetountes heautous psalmois hymnois ōdais pneumatikais en tē chariti adontes en tais kardiais hymōn tō Theō
verses.literal: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom and as you sing psalms hymns and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God
verses.literalPt: A palavra de Cristo habite em vós abundantemente, em toda a sabedoria, ensinando-vos e admoestando-vos uns aos outros, com salmos, hinos e cânticos espirituais, cantando ao SENHOR com graça em vosso coração.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν ὅ τι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ Θεῷ Πατρὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai pan ho ti ean poiēte en logō ē en ergō panta en onomati Kyriou Iēsou eucharistountes tō Theō Patri di’ autou
verses.literal: And whatever . . . . . . . . . you do in word or deed do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus giving thanks to God the Father through Him
verses.literalPt: E, quanto fizerdes por palavras ou por obras, fazei tudo em nome do Senhor Jesus, dando por ele graças a Deus Pai.

verses.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες ὑποτάσσεσθε τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Hai gynaikes hypotassesthe tois andrasin hōs anēken en Kyriō
verses.literal: Wives submit to your husbands as is fitting in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Vós, mulheres, estai sujeitas a vossos próprios maridos, como convém no Senhor.

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς
verses.transliteration: Hoi andres agapate tas gynaikas kai mē pikrainesthe pros autas
verses.literal: Husbands love your wives and do not be harsh with them
verses.literalPt: Vós, maridos, amai a vossas mulheres, e não vos irriteis contra elas.

verses.original: Τὰ τέκνα ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα τοῦτο γὰρ εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Ta tekna hypakouete tois goneusin kata panta touto gar euareston estin en Kyriō
verses.literal: Children obey your parents in everything for this is pleasing to the Lord
verses.literalPt: Vós, filhos, obedecei em tudo a vossos pais, porque isto é agradável ao Senhor.

verses.original: Οἱ πατέρες μὴ ἐρεθίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi pateres mē erethizete ta tekna hymōn hina mē athymōsin
verses.literal: Fathers do not provoke your children so they will not become discouraged
verses.literalPt: Vós, pais, não irriteis a vossos filhos, para que não percam o ânimo.

verses.original: Οἱ δοῦλοι ὑπακούετε κατὰ πάντα τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις μὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας φοβούμενοι τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Hoi douloi hypakouete kata panta tois kata sarka kyriois mē en ophthalmodouliais hōs anthrōpareskoi all’ en haplotēti kardias phoboumenoi ton Kyrion
verses.literal: Slaves obey your earthly . . . masters in everything not only to please them while they are watching but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Vós, servos, obedecei em tudo a vossos senhores segundo a carne, não servindo só na aparência, como para agradar aos homens, mas em simplicidade de coração, temendo a Deus.

verses.original: Ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Ho ean poiēte ek psychēs ergazesthe hōs tō Kyriō kai ouk anthrōpois
verses.literal: Whatever . . . you do work at it with your whole being as for the Lord and not for men
verses.literalPt: E tudo quanto fizerdes, fazei-o de todo o coração, como ao Senhor, e não aos homens,

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπὸ Κυρίου ἀπολήμψεσθε τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῆς κληρονομίας τῷ Κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti apo Kyriou apolēmpsesthe tēn antapodosin tēs klēronomias tō Kyriō Christō douleuete
verses.literal: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward It is the Lord Christ you are serving
verses.literalPt: Sabendo que recebereis do Senhor o galardão da herança, porque a Cristo, o Senhor, servis.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολημψία
verses.transliteration: ho gar adikōn komisetai ho ēdikēsen kai ouk estin prosōpolēmpsia
verses.literal: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong and there is no favoritism
verses.literalPt: Mas quem fizer agravo receberá o agravo que fizer; pois não há acepção de pessoas.
